parsed.explanation: Tier-1 universal exposure: the division's March 2025 law (effective July 2025) bars trans visitors from all multi-occupancy restrooms, changing areas and sleeping quarters by biological sex, backed by a private cause of action, with no state nondiscrimination or hate-crime recourse; it ranks among the worst states for anti-trans legislation. The parent adds entry-level document exposure — sex-marker restrictions, refusal where documents cast doubt on sex, possible fraud ineligibility — plus custody harm (conversion-therapy policies, immigration abuse) and a hostile public-opinion climate (66% backing birth-sex markers). No criminalisation of trans identity, no organised targeting or documented violence pattern, national employment and hate-crime protections, and marriage recognition partially offset. Well below reduced risk because the facility rule follows the traveller everywhere and no working remedy is documented; above high risk because discovery leads to exclusion/humiliation, not imprisonment.
